notes.title: Update Notes (alpha-0.0.13)
notes.notes:
Changed Features

 The animation of player is improved.
 Special zombies are now spawned near the player.
 The pathfinding of zombies are improved. Becaus of it, some environment objects are removed.

notes.title: Update Notes (alpha-0.0.12)
notes.notes:
Changed Features

 In map, the marker's name will be displayed when pointer over the marker.
 The player's health and stamina UI added.
 The icon is displayed on exit point in structure.
 Some frenzy state system has been changed. After escape points are activated and the zombie's count is low, the frenzy will be released and day will incoming.

notes.title: Update Note (alpha-0.0.11)
notes.notes:
Changed Features

 The higher difficulty features are integrated into the lower difficulty.
 Now the changed feature hint will appear when selecting difficulty.
 The daily strengthening of the zombie's health is increased in all difficulties
 In the forest environment, the collisions of small rocks and logs are removed in certain area.

notes.title: Update Note (alpha-0.0.10)
notes.notes:
Changed Features

 Ammunition's acquisition amount and the drop rate are slightly increased. Also, it's maximum carry amount and storage are increased.
 The controls hint added above the shortcut. It can be disabled or enabled in game settings too.
 The collision of forest environment object is improved. The small rocks are no longer collided and some environment's collision is more sophisticated.


The game settings was reset because of controls hint update. This is not about important data like a backpack, it's only for game settings.

The game balance still not completed, and I will try to improve it constantly. Please feedback through discord or forum.
